subject.title: fix: compaction usage guards and agent-loop turn correctness

question: Should `AgentOptions.prepareNextTurnWithContext` ship as a permanent public plugin SDK hook alongside `prepareNextTurn`, with the new hook taking precedence when both are supplied?
rationale: The runtime bug fixes need turn context, but exposing a parallel callback creates a durable compatibility contract that cannot be resolved solely from tests or implementation quality.

options.title: Stabilize the additive hook
options.body: Approve the public hook, document its precedence and per-run lifecycle, and add focused compatibility coverage for old-only, new-only, and both-hook configurations.

options.title: Keep the hook internal
options.body: Move the context-aware callback behind an internal session/runtime seam so the bug fixes do not expand the public plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Stabilize the additive hook
recommendation.body: Approve the public hook, document its precedence and per-run lifecycle, and add focused compatibility coverage for old-only, new-only, and both-hook configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work owns the internalized agent runtime and the affected session/compaction boundary.
